items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: I don't think. He's a barber, so...

ctx.x: I think Bill Hampton, he was in there. Uh-huh. He was playing banjo at the time. Bill Hampton. Is he? Melwin Frank on Clannett.
Oh, yeah. Is he a relation to, uh, Charlie Hamilton, Bill Hamilton? Charlie Hamilton. The piano player, there's no relation to him?
I don't think. He's a barber, so...
